cards.card_text: On the enemies who hate and persecute them On the leaders who led them astray On the wilderness they once crossed
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD your God will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.
cards.snippet: …will put all these curses upon your enemies who hate you and persecute you.

cards.card_text: Job asks his friends why they persecute him the way God does.
cards.verse_text: Why do you persecute me as God does?
cards.snippet: Why do you persecute me as God does?

cards.card_text: His friends might say, let's persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him.
cards.verse_text: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’
cards.snippet: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’

cards.card_text: They persecute the one God struck They mock the ones God healed They scorn the ones God blessed
cards.verse_text: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
cards.snippet: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.

cards.card_text: What does the psalmist say about why he is being persecuted?
cards.verse_text: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
cards.snippet: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!

cards.card_text: Israel says, "Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth…" Not once.
cards.verse_text: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—
cards.snippet: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—

cards.card_text: Israel has been persecuted many a time, from youth.
cards.verse_text: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
cards.snippet: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.

cards.card_text: Jesus also calls blessed those who are persecuted.
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
cards.snippet: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

cards.card_text: Jesus promises those persecuted because of righteousness the same thing He promised the poor in spirit.
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
cards.snippet: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus makes it personal: "Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me."
cards.verse_text: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
cards.snippet: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of…

cards.card_text: Jesus tells His listeners they're blessed when people insult and persecute them because of Him.
cards.verse_text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
cards.snippet: …great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

cards.card_text: Jesus says His listeners can rejoice when they're persecuted because of Him, because great is their reward in ___.
cards.verse_text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
cards.snippet: …great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

cards.verse_text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
cards.snippet: …great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.

cards.snippet: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

cards.card_text: Then Jesus gets practical about towns that persecute them.
cards.verse_text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next.
cards.snippet: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus says, "Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers." He says they will kill and crucify some of them, and flog others in their synagogues and persecute them from town to town.
cards.verse_text: Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town.
cards.snippet: …kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus tells the disciples they'll be handed over to be persecuted and killed.
cards.verse_text: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
cards.snippet: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of…

cards.card_text: Some will be killed and others persecuted Some will be welcomed and others ignored Some will be followed and others forgotten
cards.verse_text: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’
cards.snippet: …and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’

cards.card_text: Jesus says the disciples will be seized and persecuted, but not until after the earthquakes and signs from heaven.
cards.verse_text: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you.
cards.snippet: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you.

cards.card_text: Now because Jesus is doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews begin to persecute Him.
cards.verse_text: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
cards.snippet: …Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.

cards.card_text: If people persecuted Jesus, the master, what does He say they'll do to His disciples?
cards.verse_text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
cards.snippet: …spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word,…

cards.card_text: Then he asks them, "Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute?" That's the kind of question where everybody in the room suddenly gets REAL interested in their own sandals.
cards.verse_text: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute?
cards.snippet: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute?

cards.card_text: Saul falls to the ground and hears a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?” Friend, all that PAPERWORK, and not one page covers THIS.
cards.verse_text: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
cards.snippet: …and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”

cards.card_text: Paul says he was as zealous for God as any of them, and he persecuted this Way even to the death.
cards.verse_text: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
cards.snippet: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and…

cards.card_text: Paul falls to the ground and hears a voice: 'Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?' Saul is Paul's other name (Acts 13:9), and when somebody says your name TWICE, friend, you stop whatever you're doing.
cards.verse_text: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?’
cards.snippet: …and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?’

cards.card_text: He says he had the saints punished in the synagogues, and in his raging fury he went to foreign cities to persecute them.
cards.verse_text: In my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.
cards.snippet: …my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.

cards.card_text: Why do you persecute Me Why do you run from Me Why do you doubt Me
cards.verse_text: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice say to me in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?
cards.snippet: …a voice say to me in Hebrew, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?

cards.card_text: Then Paul turns to the people who make life hard: the ones who persecute you.
cards.verse_text: Bless those who persecute you.
cards.snippet: Bless those who persecute you.

cards.card_text: What does Paul tell the believers to do for the people who persecute them?
cards.verse_text: Bless those who persecute you.
cards.snippet: Bless those who persecute you.

cards.card_text: He persecuted the church of God He was the youngest of them He never performed a miracle
cards.verse_text: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
cards.snippet: …the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

cards.card_text: Then Paul adds another hard thing: they're persecuted.
cards.verse_text: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
cards.snippet: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

cards.card_text: True or false: Paul says that when they're persecuted, they're forsaken.
cards.verse_text: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
cards.snippet: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

cards.card_text: Persecuted it and tried to destroy it Joined it and taught its people Left it alone and moved away
cards.verse_text: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
cards.snippet: …heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

cards.card_text: Here's the story the churches of Judea hear: The man who formerly persecuted us is now ___ the faith he once tried to destroy.
cards.verse_text: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”
cards.snippet: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”

cards.snippet: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit.

cards.card_text: Paul asks the brothers why he's still being persecuted if he's still preaching circumcision.
cards.verse_text: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted?
cards.snippet: …brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted?
